newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sweet grades bolstered by narrowed Brent arb.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sweet grades bolstered by narrowed Brent arb.

text.p: U.S. sweet grades rose Friday on the narrowed arbitrage gap between the value of West Texas Intermediate and Brent, becoming the feature in a relatively subdued trading session.

Brisk trading in the sweets offset the dulled interest for sour grades, traders said. Heavy grades remained weaker, hamstrung by the U.S. government's upcoming sale from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR).
Crude outrights saw profit-taking depress prices in sympathy with front month pullbacks in the heating oil and gasoline contracts on the New York Mercantile Exchange.
